head: <commit-07>

applied.LR-01: windowed goodput (goodput_rps_window) is the parity and smoke metric
applied.LR-02: noise from CRN replicates (8 per cell) and SE over 7 independent segments, not identical re-runs
applied.LR-03: parity separates tie-break discipline: reservoir for bit-exact parity, one_draw judged against tie noise; one_draw is the training default
applied.LR-05: the theta[0] = -1 pin in the shipped spaces now works in lr-train (Space.sha fix)
applied.LR-09: AgentX smoke cells use lanes < plays
applied.LR-11: parity and lr-report cluster by segment
applied.LR-13: session_split_frac guard metric used as the session-routing evidence

rejected.LR-04: Amendment A2.5: baselines run as implemented

next_stage_notes: Calibration: start from candidate cells (cells/*.candidates.jsonl), not the int- smoke cells. Sessions and AgentX need heavier loads or tighter SLAs than B2's provisional loads with I=40 ms, S=3 (default good_frac about 1.0).
Calibration must fix the closed-loop and lanes window rule; the smoke used completion basis with no warm-up.
NON_CONTENT_KEYS changed this stage, so cell content SHAs differ from B3's build smoke; no calibrated results existed, nothing of value was invalidated.
Exact replay parity: learned-choice {feature_set: v1, theta: -e0, tie_break: reservoir}; training uses one_draw (CRN-aligned).
lr-train works on both shipped learned-choice spaces after commit <commit-07>; record --objective choice at training.

parity.caveat: sessions and AgentX cells have default good_frac_window about 1.0 at the provisional SLA, so their goodput parity is weakly informative; the 7 Mooncake cells (default good_frac_window 0.55-0.83) carry the test
parity.verdict: PASS: learned-choice@theta0 with tie_break reservoir is request-for-request identical to dynamo-default-cost-fn on 88/88 (cell, k); with the default one_draw it differs per request on 88/88 (tie relabeling) but goodput_rps_window does not differ beyond noise under the A1 rule (max |cell delta| 0.0088 < 3 x pooled sd 0.0102; segment mean delta 0.00055 < 2 x SE 0.00117). No fix needed: feature 0, tie-breaking and inputs agree.

replay_plumbing_commit: none: no change was needed in lib/kv-router, lib/mocker or lib/bindings/python; session_context already reaches policies (proved below)

sessions.observation_hypothesis: [hypothesis] the default cost fn moves 55-59% of later session turns on sessions s0 (prefix reuse 0.72-0.74 vs 0.86 under sticky-hard; lmetric moves 4-8%), apparently letting load terms outweigh overlap; at the provisional SLA this costs no goodput, so whether affinity pays off depends on calibration loads
sessions.sessionless_fallback: on the 3 Mooncake cells (no multi-turn sessions) sticky-hard and sticky-bounded are row-for-row identical to learned-choice@theta0 one_draw on 9/9 (cell, k): the fallback is the default argmin with the shared one_draw chooser
sessions.verdict: PASS: replay passes session_context to policies. sticky-session hard moved 0 later turns to another worker on every session cell and replicate, while default moved 1598-1729 of 2928 later turns on sessions s0 and 5-10 of 376-453 on AgentX A2/A3; sticky-hard routes differently from default on 2636-3198 of 3647 requests on sessions s0.

slot_discipline: every replay of this stage ran through lr-eval/lr-train and the CR/slots pool (20 slots); no out-of-pool replays

observations: Default good_frac_window under the provisional SLA: Mooncake cells 0.55-0.83; sessions s0 and AgentX A2/A3 about 1.0, so those families need heavier loads or tighter SLAs at calibration (summary.json)

lmetric@defaults beats default on all 3 Mooncake smoke cells (window goodput 4.04 vs 3.42, 1.56 vs 1.30, 5.66 vs 4.78); round_robin beats default on the two Mooncake open-loop cells (3.68 vs 3.42, 1.46 vs 1.30), consistent with setup audit F6
AgentX agentic_lanes cells (B3's unexercised path) run end to end with lanes < plays (4/11, 8/11)
